reason: It costs me nothing and I get several written prices side by side, so I can find the cheapest small system to start with instead of trusting one installer like my neighbour did. Since they only see my name, I'll try one request for a small setup and see what comes back.
objection: I only want a few panels and a small battery for now. I'm afraid the companies will ignore a small request like mine or push me toward a big expensive system, and I'm still not sure they won't find a way to keep calling me.
would_change_my_mind: If nobody replies to my small request, or a company calls me before I accept anything, I'll stop using it.
